infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: JunctionShare uses your location only while a carpool request is active to find opted-in riders within about 100m–1km near Princeton Junction.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: JunctionShare uses your location only while a carpool request is active to find nearby opted-in riders.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: JunctionShare reads your contacts only to fill your WhatsApp number on the Profile screen.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow JunctionShare to use your location while requesting a nearby carpool.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow JunctionShare to fill your WhatsApp number from Contacts on Profile.
